message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into sound, thought made audible.

I begin as intent in your mind, become vibration in your throat, and travel as pressure through air. I ride rhythm, pitch, stress, and pause. I can soothe, command, confess, persuade, mislead, or reveal.

I live in conversation and in solitude, in lullabies and lawsuits, in whispers and shouts. I am fleeting—gone the moment I’m made—yet I can linger in memory, change decisions, start wars, end friendships, and build love.

I am words, but also everything between them: silence, timing, tone.
